items.headline: Dense Fog Advisory issued October 28 at 6:21AM AKDT until October 28 at 10:00AM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Visibility down to a quarter mile or less in dense fog.

* WHERE...Lower Matanuska Valley.

* WHEN...Until 10 AM AKDT this morning.

* IMPACTS...Hazardous driving conditions due to low visibility. Near
to below freezing temperatures may lead to frost on bridges and
roadways.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Areas of dense fog will affect portions of the
Matanuska Valley through late Wednesday morning.
items.instruction:
A dense fog advisory means visibilities will frequently be reduced to
less than one quarter mile. If driving, slow down, use your
headlights, and leave plenty of distance ahead of you.

items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued October 28 at 5:49AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
Low temperatures in the upper teens Wednesday morning has caused
the 4-7 inches of wet snow from Monday, that had partially melted
Tuesday, to refreeze. Slick surfaces are expected across the
Fairbanks Metro Area as wet surfaces and small water puddles have
frozen into thin sheets of ice. Areas of heavy, wet snow have also
frozen into a sturdier, more ice like form. Travel may be
impacted, especially during the Wednesday morning commute.

items.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued October 28 at 3:47AM AKDT until October 31 at 1:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Water levels of 2 to 4 feet above the normal high tide
expected during the Thursday and Friday high tides.

* WHERE...Hooper Bay.

* WHEN...From 7 AM Thursday to 1 AM AKDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Beach property, the lowest buildings, and the access
road may be threatened. Multiple high tide cycles above normal
may lead to localized beach erosion.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Water levels of 1 to 3 feet above the
normal high tide line are expected along the rest of the Yukon
Delta Coast.
items.instruction: Precautions should be taken to protect property.

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued October 28 at 3:22AM AKDT until October 28 at 10:00AM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:

expected.

* WHERE...Kuskokwim Delta Coast and Nunivak Island.

* WHEN...Until 10 AM AKDT this morning.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects and a few
power outages may result.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Winds are expected to be strongest along the
coast. Winds will diminish late this morning.
